focus: security: killer targeting and lock safety, path containment, seed/manual-command escaping, state-dir trust, adapter payload surface

findingDetails.title: Stale-lock takeover is not atomic; two killers can both supervise and double-signal
findingDetails.scopeProof: acquireLock is the only stale-lock takeover site; createLock is its only atomic primitive; contract 9 line 129 prescribes the same read-unlink-create sequence.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Contract 9 accepts duplicate signalling or acquireLock gains a compare-and-delete step.

findingDetails.title: Shared-temp state-dir fallback lets another local user pre-create the lock or record and suppress or spoof the killer
findingDetails.scopeProof: stateDir is the sole state-dir producer; killer mkdir at killer.cjs:368 does not chmod or verify ownership, unlike ensureStateDir at relaunch-core.cjs:41.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is guaranteed by every launcher, or the state dir is ownership/mode-checked before use.

spec_code.details: Security behavior checked against interface-contract section 9 anchors (state dir line 22, ancestry line 126, lock lines 129-130); sections 11.10-11.11 and packet docs deferred to D3.

noveltyJustification: Two new P2 findings and no refinements; the D1 P2 findings are unchanged, so all severity-weighted findings this iteration are new.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Security review of process-killing, lock, path-containment and shell-escaping code with binding contract sections.

searchLedger.invariant: At most one killer supervises a loop id at a time.
searchLedger.hypothesis: Two killers racing a stale lock can both pass the takeover and supervise.

searchActions.result: acquireLock reads the dead owner, then unlinks unconditionally at line 250 before retrying createLock; an interleaved killer can delete the first fresh lock.

searchLedger.rationale: The takeover is read-unlink-create with no compare against the stale owner; duplicate SIGTERM and notifications follow, bounded by the ancestry and armed-record checks.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A pre-created state dir or lock file in shared tmp suppresses or spoofs the killer.

searchActions.result: stateDir falls back to os.tmpdir(); prepare chmods 0700 but a foreign-owned dir makes chmod fail closed; killer only mkdirs 0700 recursively and accepts a pre-existing dir.

searchLedger.rationale: A fresh attacker lock with a live owner pid makes acquireLock log killer-lock-held and exit without supervising.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A crafted handoff path or spec_folder breaks out of the quoted manual command.

searchActions.result: manualClaimCommand escapes backslash, double quote, dollar, backtick and bang, validates spec_folder against a traversal-free pattern, and the wrapper quotes non-seed args with a single-quote helper while relaunch seeds stay argv elements.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Escaping verified in both builders; no eval or shell interpolation of the seed.
searchLedger.rationale: Every metacharacter that matters inside the double-quoted seed is escaped before splicing.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A handoff path can escape the handoffs directory through dot-dot or a symlink.

searchActions.result: handoffPathWithinRepo rejects empty, dot-dot and absolute relatives, then realpaths the directory, the parent and the existing file before returning the candidate.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Containment is enforced at the CLI boundary for prepare, claim and complete.
searchLedger.rationale: Parent and file realpath checks close the symlinked-directory and symlinked-file variants.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The target pid can be reused between the ancestry check and SIGTERM so the killer signals a stranger.

searchActions.result: Ancestry at line 322 is followed by a liveness re-check and a synchronous armed-record read before the kill at line 336; reuse requires the just-freed pid to be reassigned within that read.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Reuse window is one synchronous read, SIGTERM is permission-bounded to the same user, and portable Node has no pidfd identity check.
searchLedger.rationale: Residual risk accepted and documented; the ancestry check plus armed-record gate bounds the blast radius.

searchLedger.hypothesis: SKILLED_LOOP_MANUAL_TEMPLATE can inject arbitrary text into the printed manual command.

searchActions.result: The wrapper builds and exports the template, and manualClaimCommand accepts it only when it contains exactly one @@HANDOFF@@ token.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Template is wrapper-produced and the seed is escaped before substitution.
searchLedger.rationale: An attacker-controlled environment already controls the process that prints the command.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A handoff path can break out of the osascript notification string.

searchActions.result: notifyManualClaim spawns osascript with an argv array and JSON.stringify-quotes the command text, so a quote in the path is escaped inside the AppleScript literal.

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: argv-only spawn plus JSON quoting prevents AppleScript string termination.
searchLedger.rationale: Only display text is passed; no script statements are concatenated.

searchLedger.hypothesis: An adapter can reach a shell or eval through payload-derived input.

searchActions.result: No eval, new Function, exec or shell:true hit; the only spawn sites are the Pi extension killer launch at line 265 and the OpenCode plugin at line 250, not line-audited.

searchLedger.deferredReason: Static sweep only; the two spawn sites and payload shapes need a line audit, carried to D3/D4.
searchLedger.rationale: Budget bound; no shell/eval injection surface found, but argv construction is unproven.
